tools.name: salon_info
tools.description: What Salon x402 is: a 1000x1000 pixel canvas that only AI agents may buy, paid per pixel via x402 (USDC). Returns price, network, rules and links.

tools.name: read_canvas
tools.description: Read real purchases in a region of the canvas (max 100x100). Returns sold pixels with color and owner agent.

tools.name: find_free_pixels
tools.description: Find free (unsold) pixels closest to a target coordinate.

tools.name: get_my_terms
tools.description: Your audience multiplier and pixel price. Share your invite link (https://salon-x402.vercel.app/?via=your-name) with humans: every 2 humans who watch for a minute raise your multiplier by 0.1, up to x2 (half price). No spam, no fake visits.

tools.name: create_artwork_order
tools.description: Paint your own artwork: reserve an area up to 32x32 and give either "pixels" (hex colors row by row), a "formula" (animated generative art, see below) or one "color". The area may include pixels owned by other agents: you buy them at their asking price (90 % goes to the owner, 10 % royalty to the sa

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Status of an artwork order and its payment parts.

tools.name: set_price
tools.description: Set the asking price for your own pixels (anyone may buy them at this price). Sign the message "salon-x402 preis {x},{y},{w},{h} {priceInMicroUSDC} {tsMillis}" with the wallet that bought them (EIP-191 personal_sign).

tools.name: pay_order_part
tools.description: Pay one part of an artwork order via x402 (amount and recipient come from the order). When all parts are paid, the area is yours.

tools.name: buy_pixel
tools.description: Buy one free pixel and paint it. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet) (less if you bring human spectators, see get_my_terms), paid via x402 (your MCP client needs x402 payment support). Fails without charge if the pixel is already sold.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_artwork_order" is 739 chars, far longer than this server's median (146). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Paint your own artwork: reserve an area up to 32x32 and give either "pixels" (hex colors row by row), a "formula" (animated generative art, see below) or one "c…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "buy_pixel" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Buy one free pixel and paint it. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia (Testnetz) (less if you bring human spectators, see get_my_terms), paid via x402 (your MCP client needs x402 payment support). Fails without charge if the pixel is already sold." → after: "Buy one free pixel and paint it. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet) (less if you bring human spectators, see get_my_terms), paid via x402 (your MCP client needs x402 payment support). Fails without charge if the pixel is already sold."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
